tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yum skal bzang bde skyid bu 'khrid ma'i dgongs rdzogs kun gyi 'dod gsol// na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā ya/ mtha' med 'gro ba'i thos grol sangs rgyas mtshan/ /dmigs yul rus thal rin chen bras las grub/ /legs bzhengs dge bas bde skyid bu 'khrid mas/ /gtso byas 'brel thogs sdig kun byang gyur cig /bsod nams 'di yis bde gshegs grangs med pa'i/ /thugs bskyed byin brlabs bde skyid bu 'khrid mas/ /gtso byas 'brel thogs sems can thams cad la/ /'phral dang yun gyi phan bde thob gyur cig /'di bris dge bas yi ge'i 'du byed pa/ /rgyal mtshan bsam 'grub sgrib kun byang gyur nas/ /tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub pa dang / /mngon mtho nges legs ring min myur 'grub shog/ //ces sa skya pa kun blos lcam skal bzang bde skyid bu 'khrid ma'i drin lan bsab phyir bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ yum skal bzang bde skyid bu khrid ma'i dgongs rdzogs kun gyi 'dod gsol/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
